conflicts.point: Whether decentralized open-source developer communities patch security vulnerabilities faster and more effectively than centralized proprietary APIs.

positions.stance: Open-source developer communities deploy parameter-agnostic safety filters and security patches faster than centralized enterprise providers.
Decentralized distribution creates unpatchable vulnerabilities because frozen neural parameters lack the security update mechanisms of traditional software.

conflicts.point: Whether the risks of unmitigated downstream model misuse outweigh the societal benefits of open-source technological access.

positions.stance: Regulatory restrictions on open weights impose a severe human toll by delaying medical breakthroughs and technological innovation.
The irreversible nature of public weight releases permanently shifts unmanaged safety risks onto civil society without adequate recourse.
